questions_and_answers.question_text: Which two forms are preferred for asking "Do you know...?" in a question-word question?
When may the plain nǐ zhīdao form occur?
Write the Chinese question meaning "Do you know where he is?" in both forms.
Write the Chinese question meaning "Do you know at what time the bank closes?"
Which question word appears in the embedded question here?
What are the two preferred forms?

answers.answer_text: Nǐ zhīdao bu zhīdao... and nǐ zhīdao...ma?

questions_and_answers.question_text: In which kind of question is the plain nǐ zhīdao especially likely?
Write the Chinese for "Do you know where he is?" using the choice form.

answers.answer_text: Nǐ zhīdao bu zhīdao tā zài nǎr?

articles.text:
3. A: Nǐ zhīdao bu zhīdao yínháng    Do you know at what time the bank
      shénme shíhou guān mén?         closes?

Note on No. 3

Nǐ zhīdao bu zhīdao: To ask "Do you know...?" in a question-word question, nǐ zhīdao bu zhīdao and nǐ zhīdao...ma? are preferred. Nǐ zhīdao may also occur, especially in long or complex questions.

Nǐ  |  zhīdao bu zhīdao  |  tā zài nǎr?
(You | know or not       |  he is where?)     "Do you know where he is?"

Nǐ  |  zhīdao            |  tā zài nǎr?
(You | know              |  he is where?)     "Do you know where he is?"
